During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained a small '''outpost''' on the [[Second moon of Tiragga|second]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Astred]] was in charge of the outpost, which was staffed by around 140 personnel. Sometime during the war, the base personnel were afflicted with the [[Direllian Plague]] which was introduced via bacteria in the food supplies and then went airborne. The base was quarantined and a continuous broadcast message was sent out to direct returning supply [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to nearby [[Kirtania]] to acquire [[Shiarha Root]] and the services of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]] to combat the plague.

{{RPG}}
A group of Rebel agents successfully acquired a cure for the plague, and saved the base personnel.
